targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity) AS active, current_setting('max_connections')::int AS max_connections
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(heap_blks_hit) / nullif(sum(heap_blks_hit) + sum(heap_blks_read), 0), 2) AS cache_hit_ratio_pct FROM pg_statio_user_tables
SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database())) AS size, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity) AS connections

SELECT schemaname, relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(format('%I.%I', schemaname, relname)::regclass)) AS size, pg_total_relation_size(format('%I.%I', schemaname, relname)::regclass) AS bytes FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at) AS time, 'customers' AS domain, count(*) AS events FROM iot.customer_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at), 'products', count(*) FROM iot.product_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at), 'purchase_orders', count(*) FROM iot.purchase_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at), 'product_on_orders', count(*) FROM iot.product_on_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at), 'invoices', count(*) FROM iot.invoice_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at), 'inventory_changes', count(*) FROM iot.inventory_changes WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at), 'truck_fleet', count(*) FROM iot.truck_fleet_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at), 'truck_positions', count(*) FROM iot.truck_position_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
